description: Defines a template class for managing Windows HANDLE resources with automatic cleanup, including traits for handle validation and closing, as well as tracking and verification utilities.

classes.name: GenericScopedHandle
classes.description: A template class that manages a Windows handle, ensuring proper closing and handle validity checks, with move semantics and error preservation.

classes.name: HandleTraits
classes.description: Traits class providing handle validation and closing for HANDLE types.

classes.name: DummyVerifierTraits
classes.description: A no-op verifier class for handle tracking.

classes.name: VerifierTraits
classes.description: A class for runtime tracking and verification of handle usage.

methods.name: CloseHandle
methods.description: Closes a Windows handle, implementation provided elsewhere.

methods.name: StartTracking
methods.description: Begins tracking a handle for verification purposes.

methods.name: StopTracking
methods.description: Stops tracking a handle for verification purposes.

methods.name: OnHandleBeingClosed
methods.description: Notifies the system that a handle is being closed, for verification.
